speaker: Doctor
text: The 3-day history of wrist pain with chills and malaise, combined with a recent self-resolving monoarticular knee pain and a camping trip in Minnesota, is highly concerning. Could you describe the appearance and distribution of your skin lesions?

speaker: Patient
